text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Phew— ............Yeah, that felt good!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
âLoves Only You gave the finest 
performance she could in the Kyoto Kinen, 
leaving a stunning impression of her true 
ability.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after the Kyoto Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“—In that case, our next goal will be the 
Dubai International GⅠ!”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ As one of Japan's Umamusume, I intend 
to run a race we can all be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Following last year, Almond Eye has 
announced her entry this year as well. 
Could you give us a comment on this?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...It's a huge honor to be taking on this 
challenge alongside you, Almond Eye-san. 
Having you there is also quite reassuring, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, this year I'll shine even 
brighter than Ai-san did♪ Keep your eyes 
on Loves Only You♡"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: "Oooohh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—"I saw your interview article~" Ah, 
right, it's already out, isn't it? Thanks 
for checking it out~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Your declaration was so cool!" Really? 
Yay, I'm so happy~♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You know, they asked me and it just 
slipped out♪ ...After all, it's the stage 
that's finally come into view.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
This year, I'm definitely going to put on 
the best run of all♪ Everyone, you'd 
better look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Definitely watching live!" "So hyped!" 
"Our dream is finally here!!" "Prepping 
right now!" "Watching with my family!" 
"Stay safe until race day!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Dubai expedition drawing near, 
expectations are growing higher day by day 
for both Loves Only You and her squad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And naturally, my own heart was racing. 
...The time had finally come.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You's journey up to this day 
has been filled with hardships like 
injuries; it was by no means smooth 
sailing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she never stopped walking. Facing 
hardships head-on, she has steadily moved 
forward, step by step, at her own pace—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, at last, the path was forged. 
...The path to the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We shall reach that day without incident, 
and alongside her, demonstrate the 
greatest love."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that vow in my heart, I reorganized 
what I could do in the remaining time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Believing that there would be no more 
hardships ahead—"
